objective: Add time-aware claims, advisor-only adaptive retrieval planning, and proof-carrying deterministic synthesis without weakening v1 compatibility or activating unproven retrieval policy.

cases: invalid claim status is rejected without mutating the ledger
claim write and query routes pass boundary contracts
retrieval planner remains deterministic and advisor-only
findings without evidence identity are excluded
HTTP and tool synthesis v2 routes return supported claims

failures.detail: The first retrieval-query-plan literal used an invalid untyped composite element.
failures.resolution: Use an explicit map[string]any element and rerun the full Go package test.

failures.detail: Sorting every matching claim and recomputing normalized text consumed 2297993 B/op and 6933 allocs/op at 1000 claims.
failures.resolution: Cache normalized claim search text and retain only the bounded top-K candidates before sorting.

interpretation.claim_graph: Persistence, supersession, contradiction fields, verification, provenance, branch, and commit identity are implemented and contract-valid.
interpretation.planner: The planner is useful as deterministic advice but remains unproven as an automatic policy; activation is explicitly false.
interpretation.synthesis_v2: Every emitted proof claim has a bounded evidence identity; unsupported findings are counted and excluded.
interpretation.semantic_limit: Temporal-claim linking is deterministic lexical matching, not a claim of semantic equivalence.
interpretation.promotion_policy: No live policy promotion until outcome-trained holdouts demonstrate lift and rollback safety.
